note: Offline gates of wall-pilot version 5 (the clearance brake's sink floor, haltere.liftoff.fast_race_cue.ClearanceBrakeConfig), frozen with it before any replay of version 5 was scored (only the development case minus-fast6-r4-02 was looked at: v5 withheld 0.3-0.46 m/s of brake-made sink at 26.4-29.9 s). Open-loop replays (haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py) of this tree with version 5 and with the kept version 4 (--wall-pilot configs/obstacles/wall_pilot_v4.json), and of the baseline tree for identity; scored by haltere/obstacles/wall_pilot_gates.py (score_all_v2). The recorded motion does not respond: these are the requests each version would make at the recorded states. Version 1 of these gates (turn-first version 4) is kept as wall_pilot_gates_v1.json.

baseline_tree.tree: git archive of 3decaac (the round-4 integrated stack; wall pilot v4, descent view v1), replayed with this tree's harness (haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py --tree)

variants.none: --stack none (the default pilot; Straw laps and pine-brain08-01 with the offline looming stream)
variants.shadow: --stack shadow --near-on-path (every rule of the stack computed and logged, none applied)
variants.stack: --stack on --near-on-path (the obstacle stack as the runner builds it for the flight's motor contract; this tree: wall pilot version 5)
variants.stack_wp4: --stack on --near-on-path --wall-pilot configs/obstacles/wall_pilot_v4.json (this tree with the kept version 4: the round-4 stack as flown)
variants.stack_dv1: --stack on --near-on-path --descent-view configs/pilot/descent_view_v1.json (baseline tree: its descent_view.json, version 1)
variants.stack_dv2_cthr_wp4: --stack on --near-on-path --descent-view configs/pilot/descent_view.json --throttle-column command_thr --wall-pilot configs/obstacles/wall_pilot_v4.json (the round-4 stack as flown with descent view version 2; the pilot's issued throttle is the motor's command, as in the runner)
variants.stack_dv2_cthr: --stack on --near-on-path --descent-view configs/pilot/descent_view.json --throttle-column command_thr (the round-4b stack: wall pilot 5, descent view 2; report)

B_Identity.definition: as contact_support_gates CS_Identity (the same replay pairs): stack off, shadow and the kept version 4 bit-identical to m4

B_NoSink.definition: variants stack and stack_dv1 (version 5) against stack_wp4 and stack_dv1_wp4 (version 4) on every flight: brake_sink_left, the sink the clearance brake leaves below min(the request before it, 0) on the request and the command, is 0 on every tick with version 5
B_NoSink.pass_rule: max brake_sink_left <= 1e-9 on every flight and variant

B_R402.definition: minus-fast6-r4-02, variant stack_dv1 (as flown, descent view 1) with version 5: no brake-made sink; and the case is exercised: version 4 added more than report_sink (0.01 m/s) of sink on at least min_v4_added_s
B_R402.pass_rule: v5 max sink left 0 and v4 added sink >= 1 s

B_Horizontal.definition: every Minus Two flight, variants stack and stack_dv1: on every tick where the version-4 replay braked (the clearance cap bound the request) along a ray with a horizontal part >= min_ray_horizontal, version 5's horizontal request along the horizontal projection of that ray exceeds version 4's by at most max_increase_mps (the wall brake keeps its horizontal effect)

B_Quiet.definition: Pine Valley and Straw Bale (variant stack; the Straw laps and pine-brain08-01 with the offline looming stream): seconds on which version 5 withheld more than report_sink of brake-made sink
